Snakk norsk – få teksten der markøren st: Speak Norwegian and get text at your cursor. Speech recognition runs on this Mac. No account, key or subscription is needed.
Velg hvordan du vil skrive: Choose how you want to write
Begge NB-Whisper Large-modellene følger: Both NB-Whisper Large models are included.
Velg «Tillat» når Mac-en spør. Mikrofon,: Choose Allow when your Mac asks. You can select a microphone, including BlackHole 2ch, later in Settings.
Åpne Systeminnstillinger → Personvern og: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility (Device Control and Data Access on newer macOS). Add DSSA Tale from Applications and allow access. This lets the app paste into your active text field.
Allerede slått på? Fjern den gamle DSSA: Already enabled? Remove the old DSSA Tale entry, add the app from Applications again, then restart it.

Grant both permissions before continuing. If macOS asks you to quit, reopen the app from Applications.
Uavhengig tilpasning av OpenWhispr 1.9.2: Independent adaptation of OpenWhispr 1.9.2. Not an official product of OpenWhispr or the National Library of Norway. Licenses are in the app's Resources/legal folder.
Velg eller kontroller fast mappe under I: Choose or check a fixed folder in Integrations first.
Kunne ikke åpne mappen. Kontroller mappe: Could not open the folder. Check the folder choice in Integrations.
Åpner den valgte mappen i Finder. Velg d: Opens the selected folder in Finder. Then choose the audio file below or drag it onto the app's file input.
Appen og modellmotorenes CPU-bruk, målt: CPU use of the app and its model engines, as a share of the Mac's total processor capacity.
Samlet arbeidsminne for appen og dens mo: Combined resident memory of the app and its model engines (RSS). Shared memory may be counted more than once.
GPU-tallet gjelder hele Mac-en. Separat: GPU usage is for the entire Mac. Separate app GPU usage is unavailable.
Velg modeller og les forklaringen: Choose models and read the explanation
NB-Whisper lytter til opptaket og skrive: NB-Whisper listens to the recording and writes your words. Choose Bokmål or Nynorsk. This model is required for dictation, audio import and meeting transcription.
En Qwen-språkmodell arbeider med teksten: A Qwen language model works with the text after NB-Whisper. It can clean punctuation, format notes and help draft summaries. It does not hear audio and is not required for ordinary dictation. Leave cleanup off to preserve the raw transcription.
Assistenten bruker den valgfrie språkmod: The assistant uses the optional language model to work with text. NB-Whisper is used first when converting audio into text.
Metal bruker grafikkdelen i Apple-brikke: Metal uses the graphics part of the Apple chip. CPU uses the processor and may be slower. This package does not include a Core ML encoder.
Uten hjelpemodell – prøv dette først: Without a helper model – try this first
Try without a helper model first.
Da får du teksten direkte fra NB-Whisper: You get the text directly from NB-Whisper without extra processing time or rewriting. Enable cleanup only if you want help afterwards.
Begge valgene er NB-Whisper Large. Full: Both choices are NB-Whisper Large. Full precision is a larger file of about 3.10 GB. q5_0 is the quantized version of about 1.08 GB and usually uses less memory. Try both to compare speed and recognition.
Velg nynorsk for tekst på nynorsk, eller: Choose Nynorsk for Nynorsk text, or Bokmål for Bokmål text. Nynorsk does not require an extra helper model. Your choice stays until you change it. Speech recognition can still make mistakes.
Venter på at hurtigtasten skal bli klar: Waiting for the shortcut to become ready …
Den lagrede hurtigtasten kunne ikke akti: The saved shortcut could not be activated. Use the active shortcut above or choose another combination. Your saved preference has been preserved.
NB-Whisper gjør lyd til tekst. Full pres: NB-Whisper turns audio into text. Full precision (3.10 GB) and q5_0 (1.08 GB) are both Large models. q5_0 generally uses less memory.
Velg bokmål eller nynorsk. Nynorsk treng: Choose Bokmål or Nynorsk. Nynorsk needs no helper model. Your language choice stays until you change it.
Automatisk bruker Metal på Apple Silicon: Automatic uses Metal on Apple Silicon. CPU may be slower.
En valgfri Qwen-modell rydder eller form: An optional Qwen model cleans up or formats the text afterwards. It does not replace NB-Whisper and can make mistakes.
Talemodell, målform og valgfri tekstoppr: Speech model, written language and optional text cleanup.
Velg mikrofon og høyttaler, og kontrolle: Choose microphone and speaker, and check permissions.
Velg tastene som starter og stopper oppt: Choose the keys that start and stop recording.
Lengde på opptak, lydsignaler og automat: Recording length, sound cues and automatic pasting.
Lyst eller mørkt tema, aksentfarge og me: Light or dark theme, accent colour and interface language.
Versjon, oppdateringsvalg og lokal feils: Version, update choices and local diagnostic logs.
